# Punds

> Punds is a personal hub: a single page linking to everything I build. It is
> rendered as a navigable 3D world styled after Copland OS, the operating system
> from Serial Experiments Lain. There is no article content here beyond the links
> below.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org). It exists because
the site is a WebGL scene with no server-rendered text, so a crawler that does not
run JavaScript sees an empty page. This file is the readable version.

## Where this points

- Portfolio: https://dk.punds.ch — the site worth reading. Projects, experience, CV.
- Source code: https://github.com/dominikkoenitzer
- Senbon: https://senbon.ch — deliberately not indexed, listed here for completeness.

## Notes

- This page is the hub, not the content. For questions about the person behind it,
  read https://dk.punds.ch/llms.txt instead; that one is detailed.
- Non-commercial fan homage. Serial Experiments Lain and the NAVI belong to their
  rights holders.
